DLG-SC-LOC-027-17-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-17-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 館内着はこちらでお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-17-001-SHARED-01.translation: We hand out clothing for use inside the facility here.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-17-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-17-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 上着はこのサイズでよさそうですが、ズボンの丈を見てもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-17-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 館内着のズボン丈を見たいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-17-001-SHARED-02.translation: This size looks fine for the top, but may I check the trouser length?
DLG-SC-LOC-027-17-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to check the length of the trousers provided for use inside the facility. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-17-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-17-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 見本をご覧いただけます。こちらが同じサイズです。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-17-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can look at the sample. This is the same size.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-17-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-17-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 少し長いですね。ズボンだけ一つ小さいサイズにできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-17-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 下だけ小サイズへ替えたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-17-001-SHARED-04.translation: They're a little long. Could I have just the trousers in the next size down?
DLG-SC-LOC-027-17-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you would like only the bottoms in a smaller size. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-17-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-17-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 上下で違うサイズもお渡しできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-17-001-SHARED-05.translation: We can give you different sizes for the top and bottoms.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-17-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-17-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: それでお願いします。入浴後に着たいので、今はどこにしまえばよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-17-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 上下別サイズを選び保管場所を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-17-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'd like that, please. I want to wear them after my bath, so where should I put them for now?
DLG-SC-LOC-027-17-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose different sizes for the top and bottoms and ask where to store them. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-17-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-17-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お持ちのロッカーへ、乾いた物と一緒に入れてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-17-001-SHARED-07.translation: Put them in your locker with your dry things.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-17-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-17-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ロッカーへ入れます。使用後は上と下を別の回収口に出しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-17-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 使用後の回収口を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-17-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll put them in the locker. After use, do the top and bottoms go into separate collection openings?
DLG-SC-LOC-027-17-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask which collection opening to use after wearing them. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-17-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-17-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 同じ回収口で結構です。出口にあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-17-001-SHARED-09.translation: The same opening is fine. It's by the exit.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-17-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-17-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 上下とも同じ所ですね。大きさも合いそうなので、この組合せを受け取ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-17-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 回収方法とサイズ組合せを確認し受取る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-17-001-SHARED-10.translation: Both go in the same place, then. The sizes seem to fit, so I'll take this combination.
DLG-SC-LOC-027-17-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm how to return the clothes and the size combination, then accept them. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-17-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-17-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞごゆっくりお過ごしください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-17-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please relax and enjoy your time here. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-18-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-18-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お部屋で、ご不便はございますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-18-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything in your room that's causing you inconvenience?

DLG-SC-LOC-027-18-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-18-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 枕が少し高いので、低い物があれば替えていただきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-18-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 高い枕を低い物へ替えたいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-18-001-SHARED-02.translation: The pillow is a little high, so if you have a lower one, I'd like to exchange it.
DLG-SC-LOC-027-18-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to exchange a high pillow for a lower one. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-18-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-18-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 低い枕をご用意できます。お部屋番号をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-18-001-SHARED-03.translation: We can provide a lower pillow. May I have your room number?

DLG-SC-LOC-027-18-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-18-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 八〇六号室です。二つある枕のうち、窓側のベッドの一つだけお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-18-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 室番号と窓側一枕の対象を指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-18-001-SHARED-04.translation: Room 806. Of the two pillows, please replace only the one on the bed by the window.
DLG-SC-LOC-027-18-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the room number and specify the one pillow by the window. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-18-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-18-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 一つお持ちします。今、お部屋へお届けしてもよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-18-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll bring one. May I deliver it to your room now?

DLG-SC-LOC-027-18-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-18-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今はロビーにいるので、ここで受け取れますか。自分で部屋へ持って行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-18-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: ロビーで本人受取を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-18-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'm in the lobby now. Could I collect it here? I'll take it to my room myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-027-18-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to collect the pillow yourself in the lobby. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-18-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-18-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらへお持ちします。元の枕は、椅子の上へ置いておいてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-18-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll bring it here. Please leave the original pillow on the chair.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-18-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-18-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 椅子の上ですね。明日の清掃で回収してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-18-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 旧枕の椅子保管と清掃回収を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-18-001-SHARED-08.translation: On the chair, then. Could it be collected during tomorrow's cleaning?
DLG-SC-LOC-027-18-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm that the old pillow should be left on the chair and collected during cleaning. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-18-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-18-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 清掃担当へ伝えます。こちらが低い枕です。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-18-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll let the cleaning staff know. Here is the lower pillow.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-18-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-18-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 受け取りました。部屋へ戻って窓側の枕を替え、元の物を椅子へ置きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-18-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 低枕受領後交換と旧品配置を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-18-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've got it. I'll go back to the room, replace the pillow by the window, and put the original on the chair.
DLG-SC-LOC-027-18-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: After receiving the lower pillow, say that you will exchange it and put the old one in the designated place. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-18-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-18-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞゆっくりお休みください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-18-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please have a good rest. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-19-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-19-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: コーヒー豆をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-19-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for coffee beans?

DLG-SC-LOC-027-19-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-19-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家で紙のフィルターを使います。二百グラムを、その器具に合う挽き方で買いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-19-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 紙フィルター用の二百グラム挽豆を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-19-001-SHARED-02.translation: I use a paper filter at home. I'd like 200 grams ground to suit that brewing equipment.
DLG-SC-LOC-027-19-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for 200 grams of ground coffee for a paper filter. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-19-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-19-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 器具の写真があれば拝見できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-19-001-SHARED-03.translation: If you have a photo of the equipment, I can take a look.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-19-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-19-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: これです。一度に二杯作ります。細かすぎない方がよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-19-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 器具写真と二杯抽出を伝え細かさを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-19-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here it is. I make two cups at a time. Is it better not to grind it too finely?
DLG-SC-LOC-027-19-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the equipment photo, say you brew two cups, and ask about grind size. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-19-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-19-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この器具向けには、こちらの見本の挽き方でご用意しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-19-001-SHARED-05.translation: For this equipment, we prepare it with the grind shown in this sample.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-19-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-19-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 見本の大きさが分かりました。この豆だと、酸味はどんな感じですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-19-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 見本確認後酸味を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-19-001-SHARED-06.translation: I can see the sample's grind size now. What is the acidity like for these beans?
DLG-SC-LOC-027-19-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: After checking the sample, ask about acidity. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-19-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-19-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらは、店の表示では酸味を控えめにしています。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-19-001-SHARED-07.translation: In our shop's labeling, these are rated as having mild acidity.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-19-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-19-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: それを二百グラムお願いします。百グラムずつ二袋に分けられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-19-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 豆を決定し二袋分けを頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-19-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'd like 200 grams of those, please. Could you divide it into two bags of 100 grams each?
DLG-SC-LOC-027-19-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose the beans and ask for them to be divided into two bags. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-19-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-19-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 二袋にできます。挽いた日も書いておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-19-001-SHARED-09.translation: We can do two bags. We'll write the grinding date on them too.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-19-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-19-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。一袋ずつ開けたいので、その分け方でお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-19-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 一袋ずつ開ける目的で包装を確定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-19-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I want to open one bag at a time, so please package them that way.
DLG-SC-LOC-027-19-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the packaging so that you can open one bag at a time. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-19-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-19-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご用意します。ご自宅でのコーヒーをお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-19-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll prepare them for you. Enjoy your coffee at home.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-20-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-20-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 午後の打合せに使う図面を準備しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-20-001-SHARED-01.translation: Let's prepare the drawings for this afternoon's meeting.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-20-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-20-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 平面図と工程表を持ってきました。壁に並べる順番を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-20-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 平面図工程表の掲示順を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-20-001-SHARED-02.translation: I've brought the floor plan and work schedule. Please tell me what order to display them in on the wall.
DLG-SC-LOC-027-20-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask the display order for the floor plan and work schedule. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-20-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-20-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 左に平面図、右に工程表です。通路の図もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-20-001-SHARED-03.translation: The floor plan goes on the left and the schedule on the right. Do you also have the passageway drawing?

DLG-SC-LOC-027-20-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-20-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、三枚目があります。説明中に見比べるので、平面図の下へ貼りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-20-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 通路図を平面図下へ配置提案する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-20-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, I have a third sheet. I'd like to put it below the floor plan so we can compare them during the explanation.
DLG-SC-LOC-027-20-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Suggest putting the passageway drawing below the floor plan. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-20-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-20-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その配置で結構です。今日の変更箇所はどこですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-20-001-SHARED-05.translation: That arrangement is fine. What has changed today?

DLG-SC-LOC-027-20-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-20-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 資材の搬入口が変わりました。通路図の赤い矢印を新しい方向へ書き直してあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-20-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 搬入口変更と赤矢印修正を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-20-001-SHARED-06.translation: The materials delivery entrance has changed. I've redrawn the red arrow on the passageway drawing to point in the new direction.
DLG-SC-LOC-027-20-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain the changed delivery entrance and the revised red arrow. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-20-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-20-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 変更日も入れてください。古い図と見分けられるようにしましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-20-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please add the date of the change too, so we can distinguish it from the old drawing.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-20-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-20-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日の日付を右上へ入れました。旧版は打合せ机へ並べず、資料袋に戻します。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-20-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 新版日付記入と旧版収納を実行する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-20-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've put today's date in the top right. I won't lay out the old version on the meeting table; I'll put it back in the document bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-027-20-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Add the date to the new version and put away the old version. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-20-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-20-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 準備ができたら、参加者へ変更点から説明してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-20-001-SHARED-09.translation: Once everything is ready, start by explaining the changes to the participants.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-20-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-20-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 三枚を貼れました。最初に搬入口と変更日を示して、次に工程表へ進みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-20-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 三枚掲示後説明の順序を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-20-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've put up all three sheets. I'll point out the delivery entrance and change date first, then move on to the work schedule.
DLG-SC-LOC-027-20-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: After displaying all three sheets, report the order of your explanation. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-20-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-20-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お願いします。それでは、打合せでまた会いましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-20-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please do. I'll see you again at the meeting.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-21-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-21-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 振込のお手続きですね。用紙を拝見します。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-21-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're making a bank transfer. Let me see the form.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-21-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-21-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 会費を振り込みたいです。案内に、名前の前へ会員番号を付けるよう書いてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-21-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 会費振込で依頼人名へ会員番号を付けたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-21-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to transfer my membership fee. The instructions say to put my membership number before my name.
DLG-SC-LOC-027-21-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you want to add your membership number to the sender's name when transferring a membership fee. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-21-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-21-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 依頼人の欄へ、番号とお名前をご記入いただけます。番号は何桁ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-21-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can write the number and your name in the sender field. How many digits is the number?

DLG-SC-LOC-027-21-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-21-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 六桁です。先頭がゼロですが、そのゼロも書くのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-21-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 六桁番号の先頭ゼロの記載を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-21-001-SHARED-04.translation: Six digits. It starts with zero; I should include that zero too, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-027-21-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm that the initial zero in the six-digit number should be written. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-21-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-21-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい、案内どおり六桁でご記入ください。振込金額はこちらですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-21-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes, please write all six digits as instructed. Is this the transfer amount?

DLG-SC-LOC-027-21-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-21-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、八千円です。手数料はこの金額に含まれますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-21-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 八千円への手数料包含を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-21-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, 8,000 yen. Is the transaction fee included in that amount?
DLG-SC-LOC-027-21-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether the transaction fee is included in the 8,000 yen. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-21-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-21-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この窓口では別に三百円です。合計は八千三百円になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-21-001-SHARED-07.translation: At this counter, there's a separate 300-yen fee. The total is 8,300 yen.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-21-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-21-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 八千三百円を用意します。控えにも、番号付きの依頼人名が出ますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-21-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 合計を用意し控えの番号表示を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-21-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll have 8,300 yen ready. Will the sender's name with the number also appear on my receipt?
DLG-SC-LOC-027-21-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Prepare the total and ask whether the number will appear on the receipt. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-21-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-21-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。受付前に、この用紙の記載を一緒にご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-21-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Before we process it, please check what's written on this form together with me.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-21-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-21-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 番号六桁と名前、振込先、八千円を確認しました。この内容でお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-21-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 記載した四項目を確認し実行を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-21-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've checked the six-digit number and my name, the recipient account, and the 8,000 yen. Please proceed with these details.
DLG-SC-LOC-027-21-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the four items entered and ask for the transfer to be made. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-21-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-21-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承りました。控えをお渡しします。それでは、お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-21-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. Here is your receipt. Please take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今降りた列車に傘を置いてきました。まだホームに戻れば間に合いますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 発車直後の列車に傘を忘れたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I left my umbrella on the train I just got off. If I go back to the platform now, can I still catch it?
DLG-SC-LOC-028-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you left your umbrella on the train that has just departed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 列車はもう発車しました。どのあたりに置きましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: The train has already departed. Where did you leave it?

DLG-SC-LOC-028-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 真ん中の車両の網棚です。青い長傘で、持ち手に白いテープがあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 置き場所と傘の特徴を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: On the overhead rack in a carriage in the middle. It's a full-length blue umbrella with white tape on the handle.
DLG-SC-LOC-028-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Describe where you left it and the umbrella's distinguishing features. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 忘れ物の担当へ連絡します。降りた時刻を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll contact the lost-property staff. What time did you get off?

DLG-SC-LOC-028-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 十時二十分ごろです。ここでずっと待っていた方がいいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 降車時刻を述べ待機の要否を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Around 10:20. Should I keep waiting here?
DLG-SC-LOC-028-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give the time you got off and ask whether you need to wait. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今すぐ見つかるとは限りません。お問い合わせ番号をお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: It may not be found right away. I'll give you an inquiry reference number.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 午後は外出するので、電話で状況を聞けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 外出予定を示し電話照会を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll be out this afternoon. Can I call to ask for an update?
DLG-SC-LOC-028-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Mention your plans to go out and ask to inquire by phone. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、この番号へお電話ください。お名前と連絡先をこちらにお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, please call this number. Please write your name and contact details here.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 名前と携帯番号を書きました。午後に問い合わせ番号を伝えて電話します。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 連絡先を書き問い合わせ方法を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've written my name and mobile number. I'll call this afternoon and give the inquiry reference number.
DLG-SC-LOC-028-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Write your contact details and confirm how you will inquire. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承りました。見つかった場合はこちらからもご連絡します。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. We'll also contact you if it's found. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 音声ガイドの貸し出しはこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is where you can borrow an audio guide.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 景色を見ながら聞きたいです。自分のイヤホンを使えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 私物イヤホンの使用を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to listen while looking at the scenery. Can I use my own earphones?
DLG-SC-LOC-028-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can use your own earphones. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この端末は専用のイヤホンを使います。片耳で聞く形です。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: This device uses its own dedicated earphone. You listen with one ear.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: それなら借ります。全部続けて再生されるのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 貸出を希望し再生の仕組みを聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Then I'd like to borrow it. Does it play everything continuously?
DLG-SC-LOC-028-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask to borrow it and ask how playback works. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 窓の番号を押すと、その景色の説明だけ流れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: When you press a window's number, it plays only the description of that view.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 先に港の説明を聞きたいです。何番の窓ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 港の音声案内の番号を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'd like to hear about the harbor first. Which window number is that?
DLG-SC-LOC-028-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for the number of the harbor audio guide. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 三番です。聞き直す時は同じ番号をもう一度押してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Number three. To hear it again, press the same number once more.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 三番ですね。手を空けたいので、首から下げるひもも借りられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 番号を確認しストラップを依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Number three, then. Could I also borrow a neck strap so I can keep my hands free?
DLG-SC-LOC-028-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm the number and request a strap. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、このひもをお使いください。返却は出口のカウンターです。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, please use this strap. Return it at the exit counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ひもを付けました。港から見て、帰りに出口で返します。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 借用品の使用順と返却場所を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've attached the strap. I'll start with the harbor and return it at the exit on my way out.
DLG-SC-LOC-028-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the order in which you will use the borrowed equipment and where you will return it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞごゆっくりお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take your time and enjoy your visit.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 周辺のご案内をしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like some information about the area?

DLG-SC-LOC-028-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 海沿いを散歩したいです。この建物の中を通らないと、遊歩道へ出られませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 海沿い遊歩道へ建物を通らず行けるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to walk along the sea. Do I have to go through this building to reach the promenade?
DLG-SC-LOC-028-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can reach the seaside promenade without going through the building. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 外側の通路からも出られます。あちらの階段の横をお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can also reach it from the outside passage. Please go beside those stairs.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 店には寄らずに行けますね。途中で観覧車を近くから見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 店を経由しない経路を確認し観覧車を見たいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: So I can get there without stopping at the shops. I'd like to see the Ferris wheel up close along the way.
DLG-SC-LOC-028-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm the route that does not go through the shops and say you want to see the Ferris wheel. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 遊歩道から見えます。観覧車の乗り場は別の入口なので、歩いて見るだけならそこへ入る必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can see it from the promenade. The boarding area has a separate entrance, so you don't need to enter there if you're just walking around to look at it.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 見るだけにします。帰りは買い物をしたいのですが、遊歩道から店に戻る入口はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 乗らずに眺めると述べ買い物への戻り口を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll just look at it. I'd like to shop on the way back; is there an entrance from the promenade back into the shops?
DLG-SC-LOC-028-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will look without riding and ask about an entrance back to the shops. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 左側の広場に面した入口があります。買い物フロアへ戻れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: There's an entrance facing the plaza on the left. It leads back to the shopping floor.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 広場の入口ですね。海沿いで座れる場所もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 広場入口を確認しベンチを求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: The plaza entrance, then. Is there also somewhere to sit by the sea?
DLG-SC-LOC-028-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm the plaza entrance and ask for a bench. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 遊歩道にベンチがあります。風が強ければ、広場側のベンチの方が過ごしやすいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: There are benches along the promenade. If the wind is strong, the benches on the plaza side are more comfortable.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 風の様子を見て休みます。海沿いを歩いてから、広場の入口へ戻って買い物します。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 風に合わせた休憩と散歩後の買い物を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll see how windy it is and choose where to rest. After walking by the sea, I'll return to the plaza entrance and go shopping.
DLG-SC-LOC-028-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to rest according to the wind and go shopping after your walk. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、どうぞ楽しい時間をお過ごしください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. Please have a lovely time.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 採血のあと、お加減はいかがですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: How are you feeling after the blood draw?

DLG-SC-LOC-028-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 少しふらふらします。診察まで立って待っていようと思いましたが、座りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 採血後のふらつきと着席希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I feel a little lightheaded. I was going to stand while waiting for my consultation, but I'd like to sit down.
DLG-SC-LOC-028-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Describe your lightheadedness after the blood draw and say you would like to sit. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらでお掛けください。ふらつきは採血の前にもありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please sit here. Were you feeling lightheaded before the blood draw too?

DLG-SC-LOC-028-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 採血の前はありませんでした。立ち上がった時からです。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 症状が立ち上がった時からと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: No, not before the blood draw. It started when I stood up.
DLG-SC-LOC-028-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the symptoms started when you stood up. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今の状態を確認します。ほかに気になる症状はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll check your condition now. Are there any other symptoms you're concerned about?

DLG-SC-LOC-028-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 手が冷たい感じがあります。痛みはありません。連れを呼んでもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 手の冷たさと痛みなしを述べ同行者を呼びたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: My hands feel cold. I don't have any pain. May I call the person who came with me?
DLG-SC-LOC-028-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Mention cold hands and no pain, and ask to call your companion. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、こちらへ来ていただいて構いません。呼ぶ間も立ち上がらずにいてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, they can come here. Please stay seated while you call them.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 携帯で呼びます。診察の順番が来たら、自分で移動すればいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 着席で連絡し診察への移動方法を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll call them on my mobile. When it's my turn for the consultation, should I go there on my own?
DLG-SC-LOC-028-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Contact your companion while seated and ask how to get to the consultation. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 先にこちらで状態を確認し、診察担当にも伝えます。移動する前に声を掛けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll check your condition here first and let the consultation staff know. Please speak to us before moving.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。座ったまま連れを呼びます。移動する前に、もう一度お声がけします。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 座って同行者を呼び移動前に看護師へ声を掛ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I'll stay seated and call my companion. I'll speak to you again before moving.
DLG-SC-LOC-028-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Call your companion while seated and speak to the nurse before moving. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、こちらで様子を確認します。どうぞお大事に。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, we'll check how you're doing here. Please take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 御朱印の受付はこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is the reception desk for temple or shrine calligraphy seals.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この帳面にお願いしたいです。前のページが少し湿っていますが、開いても大丈夫ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 湿ったページのある御朱印帳を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like one in this book. The previous page is a little damp; is it all right to open it?
DLG-SC-LOC-028-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about your seal book that has a damp page. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらでは触らず、空いているページを見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Without us touching that page, could you show us an unused page?

DLG-SC-LOC-028-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: このページなら乾いています。ここにお願いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 乾いた記入ページを指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: This page is dry. Could you write it here?
DLG-SC-LOC-028-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Specify a dry page for the inscription. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。書き終わった後もしばらく開いたままお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. Please keep it open for a while even after we finish writing.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: すぐかばんに入れずに持ちます。先に境内を回って、あとで受け取ってもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 乾燥中の扱いを了解し後刻受領を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll hold it without putting it straight into my bag. Could I walk around the grounds first and collect it afterward?
DLG-SC-LOC-028-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Acknowledge how to handle it while drying and ask to collect it later. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、引換札をお渡しします。三十分ほどでお戻りいただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, we'll give you a claim ticket. Could you come back in about thirty minutes?

DLG-SC-LOC-028-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 三十分後に戻ります。受け取り口は受付と同じ列ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 戻る時刻と受け取り口を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll be back in thirty minutes. Is the collection point in the same line as reception?
DLG-SC-LOC-028-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm when you will return and where to collect it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 右側の受け取り口へお越しください。札を見せていただければ結構です。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please come to the collection point on the right. You only need to show your ticket.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。札をなくさないようにしまって、境内を見てきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 引換札を携帯し参拝へ行くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I'll put the ticket away safely so I don't lose it, and go look around the grounds.
DLG-SC-LOC-028-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will keep the claim ticket with you and go to pay your respects. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お預かりします。どうぞごゆっくりご参拝ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll keep the book for you. Please take your time visiting.
